scope: Nonpublic first-pass screening; not primary-text verified
methodology: Individually assess each verse; candidate locators are research leads only, not proof of literary dependence. No external parallel required for every verse. Original/critical editions, witnesses, transmission and dating must be checked before verification.

records.summary: Affirms that only what God has decreed can befall believers, and reliance on God.
questions: Assess whether any earlier predestination/trust passage has a distinctive shared sequence rather than a generic motif.

records.summary: Contrasts the believers' two favorable outcomes with expected divine or human punishment of opponents.

candidates.difference: Paul discusses life or death in relation to Christ; the Qur'anic verse addresses polemical military outcomes and divine judgment.

questions: Check Greek critical text and dating; do not infer textual transmission from the two-outcome motif.

records.summary: Spending voluntarily or reluctantly will not be accepted from the addressed group.
questions: Look for sufficiently precise prior contrasts between voluntary and reluctant giving; do not force a generic almsgiving comparison.

records.summary: Rejects spending by those accused of disbelief and describes unwilling prayer and reluctant giving.

candidates.difference: Isaiah rebukes ritual offerings and prayer amid injustice, whereas the Qur'an explicitly names disbelief and reluctant prayer and spending.

questions: Compare Hebrew text, literary context, and critical translation; assess whether specific correspondence exceeds a generic rejected-worship motif.

records.summary: Warns not to be impressed by opponents' wealth and children; describes them as a means of distress in worldly life.

candidates.difference: Psalm 73 wrestles with the apparent prosperity of the wicked and their ultimate end; the Qur'an speaks of wealth and children as instruments of worldly punishment.

questions: Inspect Hebrew textual witness and verse numbering across editions; distinguish broad prosperity-of-wicked theme from specific textual parallel.

checkpoint.requires_reconciliation: Check authoritative main ledger, PRs and existing staging before treating as canonical or merging
checkpoint.security: Do not publish until ancient_sources RLS review (#93) resolved

publication_policy: No public writes, migrations, production changes or verified-source assertions
